findings.claim: 10-K FY2026 稱銷售與分銷模式持續演進以支援雲端、訂閱與用量計費產品，並同時保留多種取得管道（直銷＋間接通路）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1 Distribution, Sales, and Marketing
findings.excerpt: Sales and distribution models continue to evolve to support cloud-based, subscription-based, and consumption-based offerings while maintaining multiple options through which customers may acquire and manage our products and services.

findings.claim: Q3 FY26 財報：Nadella 稱按人頭業務將成為按人頭加用量業務；GitHub Copilot 2026-06-01 轉全用量計費。
findings.source: Directions on Microsoft, Q3 FY26 take-aways: consumption pricing is coming sooner rather than later
findings.excerpt: But during Microsoft’s Q3 FY26 earnings call on April 29, Microsoft’s leaders made it clear that consumption-based pricing isn’t a distant goal; it’s on the near-term horizon. “Any per-user business of ours, whether it’s productivity, coding, security, will become a per-user and usage business,” CEO Satya Nadella told analysts on the call.

findings.claim: Microsoft 將更多夥伴業務導向經銷商，直接帳單夥伴門檻提高。

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要另顯示：Q3 FY26 財報電話會 Nadella 稱按人頭業務將成為「per-user and usage」；GitHub Copilot 2026-06-01 改全用量計費（Directions on Microsoft 2026-04-30）；SoftwareOne 2026-05-21 稱 Microsoft 將更多夥伴業務導向經銷商、直接帳單夥伴門檻提高。這些僅取自搜尋摘要，未讀原頁，列為線索。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
